## Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby

A reflow oven in standby still draws **36% of its 70 kW rating = 25.2 kW** for as long as it is left on [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby]. That is a large load producing nothing, so standby is essentially wasted energy over the whole weekend [source: docs/knowledge/equipment/EQ-01_reflow_oven.md#EQ-01 Reflow Oven Manual > Energy-saving notes]. A properly switched-off oven uses only about 340–350 kWh per oven-weekend [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby].

Standby is only acceptable when boards are inside; ovens stay on for 30 minutes after the line stops, then must be switched off (and only when no boards are inside) [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby].

## Excess energy in incident S5

In incident S5 (2025-10-17 to 2025-10-20), RF-02 was left in standby all weekend. Weekend energy was about **1,556 kWh** versus about **346 kWh** normal, an excess of about **1,210 kWh** from that single oven [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby].

Note: the off-schedule rule would only flag this after 120 minutes above 20% of rating, so the real benefit comes from switching the oven off proactively rather than detecting it afterward [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby].

Based on the demand-exceedance procedure (SOP-03) and the energy policy (EM-01):

**Load shed first:** The **pressure** load is shed first. Per SOP-03, shed actions are restored in reverse order — pressure, setpoint, burn-in loading, then EV charging — which means pressure is the first to be shed and the last to be restored. [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-03_demand_exceedance_response.md#SOP-03 Demand Exceedance Response > Step 5: restore]

**Loads that must never be shed:**
- The **server room**
- **Running molders mid-cycle**
- **Reflow ovens with boards inside**

[source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-01_energy_policy.md#EM-01 Energy Policy > Operating principles]
